NewTrition Labs is looking for an experienced Deal Promotion and Community Outreach Specialist who knows how to find and place product promotions, coupon offers, free samples, and special deals in relevant online communities.

We recently received thousands of orders after one of our free-product offers was shared in a Facebook deal group. We now want to develop a controlled and repeatable process for promoting future offers through qualified Facebook groups, Instagram deal pages, TikTok deal creators, freebie websites, coupon communities, and other online deal platforms.

This is not a general social media management, content-calendar, or paid-advertising position. • Research active Facebook deal, coupon, discount, freebie, and product-sampling groups and pages. 
• Find relevant Instagram deal and freebie accounts. 
• Identify TikTok creators and accounts that regularly share consumer deals and free-product offers. 
• Research legitimate coupon, freebie, product-sampling, and deal websites. 
• Review the posting and self-promotion rules for every group, account, or website. 
• Contact group administrators, page owners, creators, editors, or website representatives to request approval or submit our deal. 
• Use official merchant-submission procedures when direct self-promotion is not permitted. 
• Post or arrange the placement of company-approved deals. 
• Use only the promotional copy, product claims, pricing, graphics, links, and terms supplied or approved by NewTrition Labs. 
• Use a unique tracking link and promotional code for each placement. 
• Maintain a detailed spreadsheet containing: 
o Platform and community name 
o Live link 
o Administrator or contact information 
o Audience size 
o Type of audience 
o Posting rules 
o Free or paid placement 
o Date contacted 
o Submission status 
o Publication date 
o Promotional code and tracking link 
o Results 
• Provide screenshots and live links for every published promotion. 
• Monitor active placements and notify us immediately if a promotion begins generating unusually high activity. 
• Remove, update, or request removal of expired promotions when necessary. 
• Provide a performance report showing traffic, orders, engagement, and results by source.

• Proven experience finding and posting promotions in Facebook deal or freebie groups, Instagram deal pages, TikTok deal communities, or online coupon and deal websites.

• Strong internet research and organizational skills. 
• Strong written English.

• No paid placement without our written approval.

full_description:
We are seeking an experienced Construction Manager / Owner's Representative to oversee the complete execution of a residential home expansion and renovation project in Secaucus, New Jersey.

The architectural design and engineering phase is being completed separately. We are looking for someone to take over once the plans are finalized and manage the project through final completion and occupancy.

This is a management role—not necessarily a hands-on construction position. We are looking for someone who will represent our interests throughout the project.

Scope of Services

Responsibilities may include:

Reviewing architectural and engineering plans for constructability
Assisting with permit coordination and municipal approvals
Developing a realistic construction budget
Preparing bid packages and obtaining competitive subcontractor pricing
Evaluating contractor proposals and making recommendations
Negotiating contracts with subcontractors and suppliers
Creating and maintaining the project schedule
Coordinating inspections and ensuring code compliance
Managing day-to-day construction activities
Coordinating all trades throughout the project
Monitoring quality of workmanship
Reviewing change orders and controlling costs
Verifying completed work before approving payments
Identifying issues before they become costly problems
Providing regular progress reports with photos and updates
Managing punch list completion through project closeout
Project Overview

The project includes a substantial expansion and renovation of an existing single-family home. Work will include structural modifications, framing, roofing, exterior finishes, mechanical, electrical, plumbing coordination, insulation, drywall, flooring, trim, painting, cabinetry, and final finishes.

The selected Construction Manager will oversee the project from mobilization through final inspections and certificate of occupancy.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone with:

10+ years of residential construction management experience
Experience managing home additions and major renovations
Strong knowledge of NJ residential building codes
Ability to coordinate multiple subcontractors simultaneously
Excellent scheduling and organizational skills
Experience with budgeting and cost control
Strong communication skills
Ability to identify potential construction issues before they become problems

Preference will be given to candidates with experience managing projects valued between $500,000 and $1.5 million.

To Apply

Please include:

Your resume or company profile
Photos or descriptions of similar projects you've managed
Your role on those projects
Your preferred compensation structure (hourly, fixed fee, or percentage of project cost)
References from recent residential projects
Your expected availability
